verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships an official CLI binary (`local-ai`) documented for core workflows: listing/installing models (`local-ai models list`), running models (`local-ai run huggingface://...`, `local-ai run ollama://gemma:2b`), and an agentic shell mode (`local-ai chat`) that reads files and runs commands behind an approval gate, aligning well with agentic/AI-native usage. missing for 10: a dedicated full CLI reference/flag documentation page and independent (non-vendor) confirmation of CLI behavior.
